members.name: unlocalizedName

members.name: BaseAttribute
members.note: no dynamic construction: the six attributes are fixed enum entries whose base and cache are seeded from ATTR_DEFAULT at attrs_init

members.name: hashCode

notes: Attribute names and defaults live as the ATTR_NAME/ATTR_DEFAULT/ATTR_MIN/ATTR_MAXV const tables at the top of living.c (lines 111-115). Verified against the shared instructions' grep list; no symbol named after this class exists in native. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers; watched-attribute sync is folded into player.c. Formerly listed as missing: the shouldWatch flag and its getShouldWatch/setShouldWatch accessors have no native counterpart: the client never receives attribute sync packets, the sprint speed quirk is hardcoded client-side in player.c.
